verses.commentary: Moab burned the bones of Edom's king to lime. Desecration of the dead. Even treatment of enemies' corpses matters to God. Dignity extends beyond death.
Fire on Moab, fortresses of Kerioth consumed. Tumult, war cries, trumpet blasts. The noise of war repays the sacrilege of desecration.
Ruler and officials killed together. The whole power structure falls. No one escapes the sweep of judgment.
Now the net tightens. Judah judged. They rejected the law of the Lord. Not cruelty to others but unfaithfulness to God. False gods led them astray. Covenant people fail the covenant.
Fire on Judah, fortresses of Jerusalem consumed. The holy city is not exempt. Having the temple does not guarantee safety when hearts stray.

Israel. The hammer falls. All the surrounding nations were prelude. They sell the innocent for silver, the needy for a pair of sandals. Justice perverted for profit. Human beings priced cheaper than shoes.

They trample the poor into dust. Father and son use the same girl. Sexual exploitation joins economic oppression. The powerless suffer both wallet and body. My holy name profaned by my people's behavior.

They recline on garments taken in pledge. The law required returning a poor man's cloak by sunset (Exodus 22:26). They keep it overnight, using it as a worship mat. Religion funded by theft from the poor.
Yet I destroyed the Amorites before them. God recounts his saving acts. Giants like cedars, strong as oaks. God cleared the land of obstacles. Redemption history becomes indictment.
I brought you from Egypt, led you forty years. The exodus, the wilderness wandering, the gift of the land. All God's doing. Israel's privilege is Israel's responsibility.
I raised up prophets and Nazirites. Spiritual gifts for spiritual guidance. Prophets to speak truth, Nazirites to model consecration. God equipped them for faithfulness.
But you made the Nazirites drink wine. You commanded the prophets not to prophesy. They corrupted the consecrated and silenced the speakers. Systematic suppression of God's voice.
I will crush you like a cart loaded with grain. The weight of their sin presses down. What stored abundance they thought they had becomes the weight that crushes them.
The swift cannot flee. The strong cannot muster strength. The warrior cannot save his life. All human capacities fail when God moves.
The archer cannot stand. The fleet-footed cannot escape. The horseman cannot survive. Every military advantage evaporates.
Even the bravest will flee naked. The most courageous stripped of dignity. Shame completes the defeat. What began in exploitation of the naked poor ends in the nakedness of the exploiters.
